subject: CAIQ: deployment affinity & runtime routing - artifact request
messages:
From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@pelicanhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: mapping of 'Deployment Affinity' (CCM/CSA) + runtime routing artifacts

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Pelican Health's security team has a handful of CAIQ items that need clarification before we move to procurement. Two specific asks from our side:

1) "Deployment affinity" / runtime routing controls (we need the control crosswalk to CCM v4.0 + short artifact proving how requests are routed by policy).
2) Evidence showing tenant isolation / KV cache boundaries in a multi-tenant hosted setup (sample log or trace showing tenant-tagging).

Can you supply a control map that ties the CAIQ questions to Redwood controls and a small set of artifacts for the reviewers? Ideally: a diagram, a short CSV crosswalk, and a sample log extract. Our audit window is next week.

Happy to loop in engineering if helpful — Aaron (cc'd) owns the compliance checklist on our side.

Thanks,
Leah Ortiz
Senior Compliance Analyst
Pelican Health

Attachments: none

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@pelicanhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: mapping of 'Deployment Affinity' (CCM/CSA) + runtime routing artifacts

Leah — thanks for the clear asks. We'll produce a compact package that maps the CAIQ entries to our internal controls and includes the artifacts you requested. A few quick clarifying notes so we scope correctly:

- When you say "deployment affinity", do you need the mapping to the CSA CCM control that references "deployment topology and affinity" specifically, or are you focused on the routing policy (latency/region/cost tiers) that influences affinity? We can extract both but it changes which artifacts we include.
- For KV cache tenancy: we can provide a redacted trace showing tenant-tagged keys and a separate design diagram that illustrates cache population and eviction boundaries. That log sample will be redacted but timestamps/tenant ids will be preserved for lineage.

Plan: Kimberly will assemble the control crosswalk (CSV), Marissa will provide the contractual-friendly summary for procurement, and I'll pull the runtime diagram and routing-policy table. We'll aim to send a first draft in ~5 hours.

Can you confirm preferred delivery format (Docx + attachments, or a single zipped bundle uploaded to your portal)?

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@pelicanhealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ: mapping of 'Deployment Affinity' (CCM/CSA) + runtime routing artifacts

Leah — forwarding a compact package from our ops team below.

Please review the attached crosswalk (routing-policy-table.csv) which maps the CAIQ question IDs to Redwood control IDs and includes a short rationale column for auditors. The diagram shows routing affinity lanes (deployment-affinity-arch.png).

Short notes:
- Control mapping covers CCM v4.0 controls CC-3.1 (network segmentation), CC-5.2 (configuration and deployment policies), and A-2.4 (runtime decisioning). Each row in the CSV points to the evidence artifact we are attaching.
- The KV cache sample (kv-cache-sample-log.txt) is a 10-line redacted extract with tenant tags and entry TTLs; it is sufficient for audit sampling.
- We've included a link to the public-facing doc that describes policy fallback behavior when a primary region is saturated.

If you want, we can add a brief narrative that maps auditor language ("requires proof of per-tenant isolation") to the artifact lines.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Principal, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: deployment-affinity-arch.png (diagram), routing-policy-table.csv (control crosswalk)

From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@pelicanhealth.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Aaron Mills <aaron.mills@pelicanhealth.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: mapping of 'Deployment Affinity' (CCM/CSA) + runtime routing artifacts

Thanks — helpful package and the CSV looks good at first glance. A couple of follow-ups before we close our intake:

1) Can you add the CAIQ question IDs in the CSV header (some of our reviewers still reference the CAIQ numbering).
2) For the KV cache log sample: include a 1-2 sentence annotation that explains how tenant tags are injected and where TTL enforcement occurs (helps the auditor find the lines of interest).
3) Do you support a short (15-min) walkthrough with our auditor Wednesday morning? If so, please include the preferred Zoom link and the attendee list.

Marissa — can you confirm whether we should expect the final bundle as a zips upload to our portal (we prefer single-zip)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Leah
